title: convolvulus sabatius subsp. mauritanicus
intro: Convolvulus sabatius subsp. mauritanicus, commonly known as Moroccan Hollyhock, is a plant species belonging to the Convolvulaceae family. It is known for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its various health benefits, such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions include acting as a sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-arrhythmic agent, making it useful in treating anxiety, insomnia, and heart conditions. The bioactive constituents of Convolvulus sabatius subsp. mauritanicus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
